source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.8.0, data build 981, released 2026-10-14

data.summary:
Whenever a friendly **WULFEN** model up to 6" from this unit is destroyed in the [Fight phase](vsdata:core-rule/fight-phase), if its unit is yet to be picked to fight in this phase, roll a D6.

On a 4+, remove the model only when its unit has fought or the phase ends, whichever is first.

reminder.unresolved: Withheld as a class: independent reviews found 4 of 86 sampled reminders of unit abilities wrong or partly wrong, above the 2% this reading may ship with.

trigger.model: friendly WULFEN model within 6 inches of owner unit

effect.removeWhen: that model's unit has fought or the phase ends, whichever comes first
